## Why Choose Cleveland Clinic?

[patient centered care icon]

### Patient-centered care:

We don’t just care for your health conditions. We care about you. That means [our providers][65]
take the time to listen to what’s important to you before recommending next steps.

[national recognition icon]

### National recognition:

Cleveland Clinic is recognized in the U.S. and throughout the world for its expertise and care.

[skilled and collaborative providers icon]

### Collaborative providers:

You’ll get care from board-certified and fellowship trained experts who work together to create a
treatment plan just for you. Only the highest standards ensure [excellent outcomes][66].

[Innovation and Research Icon]

### Innovation and research:

We’re focused on today — and tomorrow. Our focus on [research][67] and offering the latest options
means you can find a wide range of [clinical trials][68] and other care that you can’t find
elsewhere.

## For Providers

Explore a curated collection of helpful resources and tools for medical professionals

### Institutes & Departments

Connect with expert teams across our [Institutes and Departments][91] to collaborate on patient care
and drive better outcomes.

### Join Our Nursing Team

Whether you’re just graduating from nursing school or have years of experience, you can build an
exceptional career in [nursing at Cleveland Clinic][92].

### Careers

As one of the nation’s — and the world’s — leading academic medical centers, you can grow in a
setting where you’ll make a difference. [Find your career][93] at Cleveland Clinic.

### Refer a Patient

We welcome the opportunity to partner with you in caring for your patients. Our dedicated [Referring
Physician team][94] is available from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. EST every day for you and your patients.

### ConsultQD

A [site for physicians and healthcare professionals][95] from Cleveland Clinic. Discover the latest
research insights, innovations and treatment trends.

### Education

We’re dedicated to training the next generation of healthcare professionals. Explore the [training
and education programs][96] we offer worldwide.

### Research

We’re committed to improving care and finding tomorrow’s cures. Learn about our [cutting-edge basic,
translational and clinical research][97].

### View All Resources for Providers

View our [full list of resources][98] for medical professionals, including our Alumni Association,
DrConnect, and MyPractice.

Relationships are fundamental to our process at Safety National^{®}. We develop true partnerships
with our clients fostered by active listening and a deep commitment to finding solutions. We
communicate early and often, keeping every promise we make along the way.

[Learn more about our company.][78]

[Safety National - Persistent Versatility]

# Persistent Versatility

Brokers love to work with Safety National^{®} because of our flexible and customizable approach. We
offer personalized treatment to each client and, as a flat organization, we can promptly make
decisions and respond quickly to questions or concerns.

[Learn more about our insurance and reinsurance solutions.][79]

[Safety National - Add Value at Every Opportunity]

# Add Value at Every Opportunity

Safety National^{®} serves as a steadfast ally to our clients. We provide a suite of risk management
services to help prevent employee injuries and deliver unique catastrophic claims expertise to help
achieve the best possible outcomes when the worst happens.

[Learn more about our risk services.][80]

[Learn more about our claims services.][81]

[Safety National - Industry Expertise That Is Second to None]

# Industry Expertise That Is Second to None

As an industry leader, Safety National^{®} stands firm in the belief that it is the company’s
responsibility to share its specialized expertise. We value our reputation as a trusted source on
industry trends and emerging needs.

[View our thought leadership resources.][82]

# Our Remarkable Story

See how Safety National^{®} – a small company born out of excess workers’ compensation market
instability concerns during World War II – evolved into one of the leading providers of insurance
and reinsurance solutions within the United States.

[View our timeline of company milestones.][83]

### **Pediatric Urgent Care**

Our urgent care centers are staffed with clinicians experienced in treating pediatric conditions
when you need medical care immediately. We work with you so you know exactly what the diagnostic
steps are to a healthy recovery.

[ Read More ][71]
[A woman with gray hair and a face mask sits in a medical office, holding her phone, and speaks with
a healthcare professional also wearing a face mask at the urgent care clinic.]

### **Urgent Care**

Get immediate care for emergencies that don’t necessarily require a trip to the ER. From accidents
and injuries to colds and flus, our team of specialists provide expert care for life’s small
emergencies. With on-site lab and x-ray equipment, we can handle more severe urgent care services,
such as broken bones and burns, that a walk-in center cannot.

[ Read More ][72]
[A doctor in a white coat checks the pulse of a patient while seated at a desk with a clipboard at
an urgent care clinic.]

### **Primary Care**

Our primary care services deliver prompt medical care at a substantially lower cost. If you are
looking for a primary care clinician but the high cost of  medical care is a barrier, call your
nearest AFC center to get the care you need.

[ Read More ][73]
[A healthcare professional at an urgent care facility examines a baby with a stethoscope while the
baby is held by an adult.]

### **Family Care**

Our experienced and compassionate team provides full-service family care with the ease of a walk-in
clinic.  We offer routine physicals, and treatment for illness and injury.  Our express lab speeds
diagnostic and screening services when time is of the essence.

[ Read More ][74]
[A gloved hand places a blood sample vial with a purple cap into a machine containing similar vials
at the medical center.]

### **On site Labs**

Our express lab services offer diagnostics and speedy test results without having to go to another
medical facility. If your primary care provider requires you to go to the nearby hospital or clinic
for your tests, choose the one-stop shop of our AFC medical centers.

[ Read More ][75]
[An elderly man in a white shirt holds a tissue to his nose, appearing to sneeze or blow his nose.
Seated in a room with a television in the background, he might be contemplating whether to visit an
urgent care center.]

### **Seasonal Allergy Treatment**

Seasonal allergy symptoms can flare up in the spring when there’s a lot of pollen in the air.  If
seasonal allergies make you miserable year after year, call AFC and our professional medical team
will help identify your allergy and reduce your discomfort.

Most wellness programs offer one thing: a step tracker, an EAP, or a gym discount. Avidon is a
single platform covering all major behavioral drivers of chronic disease, from coaching and courses
to challenges and health risk identification. It replaces the patchwork, not just one piece. Plus,
with our completion rates, your employees will actually use it.
How do we know employees will actually use it?+
Engagement is our strongest metric. 91% of participants complete our courses. 88% achieve their
health goals. 91% say Avidon was essential to their success. We achieve this through proven
behavioral science (CBT-based course design), gamification (challenges and leaderboards), and
personalized health coaching that meets people where they are.
We don't have the budget for a wellness program.+

insurance premiums add up quickly. Avidon costs a fraction of hiring a wellness coordinator or
running in-house programs. We offer flexible plans including month-to-month options and pilot
programs. [See our pricing page for details][111].
We don't have the HR resources to manage another program.+
That's exactly who we built this for. Avidon is turnkey and self-managed. Courses launch
automatically, challenges run monthly with no admin work, and reporting dashboards update in
real-time. No IT support required for setup. You configure it once and it runs.
Is the platform HIPAA-compliant?+
Yes. Avidon is fully HIPAA-compliant with secure messaging, encrypted data storage, and
enterprise-grade security protocols. We sign BAAs with all clients and follow strict data handling
procedures.
How long does implementation take?+
Most clients launch within minutes, not months. We handle the setup, including branding, SSO
configuration, and member onboarding. Your team gets immediate access to courses, challenges, and
coaching tools.
Can we customize it for our organization?+

## Common Questions About Employee Wellness Programs.

We already have a wellness solution. Why switch?+
Most wellness programs offer one thing: a step tracker, an EAP, or a gym discount. Avidon is a
single platform covering all major behavioral drivers of chronic disease, from coaching and courses
to challenges and health risk identification. It replaces the patchwork, not just one piece. Plus,
with our completion rates, your employees will actually use it.
How do we know employees will actually use it?+
Engagement is our strongest metric. 91% of participants complete our courses. 88% achieve their
health goals. 91% say Avidon was essential to their success. We achieve this through proven
behavioral science (CBT-based course design), gamification (challenges and leaderboards), and
personalized health coaching that meets people where they are.
We don't have the budget for a wellness program.+
Unhealthy employees cost far more than a wellness program. Absenteeism, presenteeism, and higher
insurance premiums add up quickly. Avidon costs a fraction of hiring a wellness coordinator or
running in-house programs. We offer flexible plans including month-to-month options and pilot
programs. [See our pricing page for details][111].
We don't have the HR resources to manage another program.+
That's exactly who we built this for. Avidon is turnkey and self-managed. Courses launch
automatically, challenges run monthly with no admin work, and reporting dashboards update in
real-time. No IT support required for setup. You configure it once and it runs.
Is the platform HIPAA-compliant?+
Yes. Avidon is fully HIPAA-compliant with secure messaging, encrypted data storage, and
enterprise-grade security protocols. We sign BAAs with all clients and follow strict data handling
procedures.
How long does implementation take?+
Most clients launch within minutes, not months. We handle the setup, including branding, SSO
configuration, and member onboarding. Your team gets immediate access to courses, challenges, and
coaching tools.
Can we customize it for our organization?+
Yes. Our no-code platform lets you personalize content, challenges, branding, and communication
without IT support. You can white-label the experience, configure SSO, set up custom wellness hubs,
and automate outreach. APIs and webhooks are available for deeper integrations.

## Gamification for healthier and more engaged employees

[Achieve more with gamification."]

The Changers Fit App tackles a key challenge in behavioral economics: simply knowing something
doesn’t change how we act. But when knowledge translates into tangible rewards, it motivates people
to embrace healthier habits, become more mindful, and take action for the climate.

“Compared to other health activities, Changers has been very well received: one third of the
employees have signed up – and without extensive advertising. ... Changers is contemporary, the app
combines many elements – nutrition, meditation, prevention, running, safety at work, cycling. An
all-round successful offer for our employees.”
[Steffen P.]
Steffen P.Employee & Social Affairs Officer Lidl
“The “bonus principle” of Changers is exactly the way we consider successful to create awareness for
CO2 savings among the population: I am doing something for myself and thus for climate protection at
the same time. Initially, setting this up for individual companies activates the employees. The
premiums provided by the company are offset against Gold Standard CO2 certificates from ADVANTAG.”
[Raik H.]
Raik H.Managing Director ADVANTAG Services GmbH
“The main focus for us is the opportunity for our colleagues to do something good for the
environment and promote health at the same time. The app motivates because our employees can plant
trees by choosing environmentally conscious means of transport. We raise awareness of Changers via
our intranet and are happy to see increasing numbers of participants. The feedback from staff is
very positive, we really like the app.”
[Silke D.]
Silke D.Corporate Responsibility Manager EY
“The app never gets boring for our employees - there’s always something new happening.”
Rifka P.Expert Health, Work & Family, ING

**The benefits of corporate health**

Scientific research has shown the financial benefits to companies of comprehensive wellness
programmes. We can design bespoke programmes to increase and maintain the fitness of employees over
their working lifetime. These can take the form of regular medical examinations for the workforce at
which general health issues such as weight, blood pressure stress and regular exercise are
discussed, or specially designed events which meet the specific needs of a company and its
workforce.

Any business is likely to encounter a variety of problems related to health. These health issues can
reduce productivity and increase loss of revenue. These may be individual problems like returning an
employee to work following illness or injury, checking employees health before hiring or broader
issues related to general working conditions, stress in the workplace , noise exposures and many
others.

A healthy workforce is a happy and more productive one and our corporate occupational health
services are designed to help you address any health issues in a cost effective manner.

programmes. We can design bespoke programmes to increase and maintain the fitness of employees over
their working lifetime. These can take the form of regular medical examinations for the workforce at
which general health issues such as weight, blood pressure stress and regular exercise are
discussed, or specially designed events which meet the specific needs of a company and its
workforce.

Any business is likely to encounter a variety of problems related to health. These health issues can
reduce productivity and increase loss of revenue. These may be individual problems like returning an
employee to work following illness or injury, checking employees health before hiring or broader
issues related to general working conditions, stress in the workplace , noise exposures and many
others.

A healthy workforce is a happy and more productive one and our corporate occupational health
services are designed to help you address any health issues in a cost effective manner.

## Doctors on Duty Offers Urgent Care, Primary Care & Occupational Medicine Services on the Central
## Coast

Our mission is to provide fast, affordable medical services to the communities we serve in Monterey
and Santa Cruz counties. We’ve been helping people with urgent medical problems since 1988 and
understand the healthcare needs of residents on the Central Coast. Our highly skilled staff and
providers offer essential health care services at a lower cost than an emergency room and with a
shorter wait time.

[Read More][21]

We’re the medical clinic you and your family can turn to when you simply can’t wait to be seen at a
traditional doctor’s office. We provide care for non life-threatening conditions – whether it’s a
cold or flu, a broken bone or allergic reaction, or even a minor burn or sprain – when are where you
need it in one of our 9 clinics. We also provide traditional primary care services, including school
and sports physicals, wellness exams, flu shots, x-rays, immunizations and rapid lab tests.
We understand that life is unpredictable. At our walk-in clinics, we see patients with or without an
appointment and many of our clinics are even there for you on nights, weekends, and holidays. We
accept most major forms of insurance, including Medicare and CCAH. We also welcome self-pay patients
with or patients with high deductible plans. Our fees vary by the treatment given but our prices are
a fraction of the cost of an emergency room visit.
Whenever you need us, we’ll be there. Simply find the location nearest you in Salinas, Monterey, or
Santa Cruz, and come in for fast and affordable care. You can hold a place in line or set up a
virtual visit by visiting our website.

[Services the Central Coast]

### [URGENT & PRIMARY CARE][22]

Can’t wait for an appointment to see a doctor? At Doctors on Duty you don’t need an appointment.
Just walk into one of our 9 convenient locations or grab a spot in line on our website.

### [OCCUPATIONAL MEDICINE][23]

We can help with keeping your employees healthy and productive with our Industrial Medicine
services. We perform pre-employment exams, drug screens, hearing tests and other health surveillance
services. We can also care for injured workers and manage their return to full duty.

### [SPECIALTY SERVICES][24]

Doctors on Duty Medical Clinics offer a comprehensive set of services for our patients including
Pain Management, Behavioral Health and Gynecology. Direct access to these specialties within our
clinics offers convenient, timely referrals to the care you need.

[TEKLİF AL][28]

## OSGB Hizmetleri

İş sağlığı ve güvenliği (İSG) kanunu tüm çalışanları kapsamaktadır. Efor OSGB; Çalışma ve Sosyal
Güvenlik Bakanlığı (ÇSGB) İSGGM tarafından yetkilendirilmiş, İstanbul Ortak Sağlık Güvenlik
Birimi’dir. Tecrübeli işyeri hekimi ve iş güvenliği uzmanlarımızla; işyerinizde çalışanlarınız daha
sağlıklı, güvenli ve verimli olacaklar. [OSGB Hizmeti >>][29]

## Sertifikalı Eğitimler

İş sağlığı güvenliği mevzuatı gereği tüm çalışanların temel İSG eğitimi alması zorunludur. Ayrıca
sertifikalı olarak; Acil Durumlar, Yangınla Mücadele, Deprem, Yüksekte Güvenli Çalışma ve
ilkyardımcı Eğitimleri organize etmekteyiz. Eğitimlerimizle işletmeniz ve çalışanlarınız risk ve
tehlikelere karşı çok daha bilinçli ve hazırlıklı olacaktır. [İSG Eğitimi >>][30]

## Diğer Hizmetler

Efor OSGB İstanbul olarak, Şirketlerin tüm İSG ihtiyaçlarına stratejik çözüm ortağı olmayı
amaçlamaktayız. İSG risk değerlendirmesi raporu, Acil durum eğitim tatbikatları, sağlık raporu,
işyeri ortam ölçümleri, periyodik test ve kontroller, ISO 45001 İSG YS kurulması ve bağımsız İSG
denetimi gibi, katma değerli hizmetler sunmaktayız. [Mobil Sağlık >>][31]

İş kazalarını ve meslek hastalıklarını önleyerek; işyerlerinin daha sağlıklı ve güvenli olması için
çalışıyoruz.

[**Everwell** ][53]are Nationwide providers of flexible **Occupational Health Services**, Health
Surveillance, Occupational Health Assessments and Medicals across the **UK**. We provide convenient
workplace, remote and off-site (face-to-face) services to all types of organisations from SMEs to
large single & multiple site operations, for both private and public bodies.

> [Everwell Occupational Health][54]

Occupational Health Assessment

Everwell can arrange an Occupational Health Assessment or examination with a subsequent management
report for your employees throughout the UK.

Our mission is to [**“Make a Difference”** ][56]and help our clients achieve maximum staff
productivity and minimise their costs by maintaining the health and well-being of their employees.
We look to eliminate and prevent any work related causes of ill-health, to help make the workplace a
safe environment and to facilitate the quick and safe return to work of any employees who have been
off work through sickness absence.

## Hear From Other Nurses

Each nurse’s journey is unique. We aim to highlight their firsthand experiences, providing an
insider’s perspective on the nursing profession.

One of the most rewarding aspects of my 20-year nursing career is the diverse opportunities
available. I’ve worked in various settings, including labor and delivery, ambulatory care, the
Intensive Care Unit, home health, informatics, leadership roles, and clinical practice. I love
helping people at all stages of life and am very proud or my nursing profession.

[Nursing Careers, Programs, & Resources]

### Marlyn C.

#### MSN, RN

One of the most fulfilling aspects of nursing is the profound connections we build with our
patients. Despite often encountering them during challenging times – supporting them through health
crises, witnessing births, or providing end-of-life care – we quickly establish deep bonds and play
a pivotal role in their lives.

[Nursing Careers, Programs, & Resources][Nursing Careers, Programs, & Resources]

### Susan A.

#### DNP, RN, CNL

One of the most rewarding aspects of nursing is the ability to explore various roles and specialties
while remaining in the same profession. Throughout my 15-year nursing career, I’ve transitioned
between roles in med-surg, critical care, case management, and ER and received training in several
other areas. Nursing offers endless opportunities for change and growth – if you’re feeling burnt
out or something new is a better fit for your life, your skills can easily be applied to a new area
within nursing.

patients. Despite often encountering them during challenging times – supporting them through health
crises, witnessing births, or providing end-of-life care – we quickly establish deep bonds and play
a pivotal role in their lives.

while remaining in the same profession. Throughout my 15-year nursing career, I’ve transitioned

other areas. Nursing offers endless opportunities for change and growth – if you’re feeling burnt
out or something new is a better fit for your life, your skills can easily be applied to a new area
within nursing.

### KUDUWAVE PORTABLE AUDIOMETER USED BY NASA ASTRONAUTS

 “NASA recently deployed a modified Kuduwave audiometer to the International Space Station (ISS).
Space-X’s Crew-2 astronauts used this Kuduwave to successfully complete an inaugural series of
audiometry and tympanometry tests aboard the ISS.

The Kuduwave’s unique noise attenuation and noise monitoring features are well suited for the
challenge of assessing hearing in ambient noise levels created by the ISS’s multiple fans and
hardware systems.

The astronauts’ collected data are now being analyzed at the Johnson Space Center Audiology Clinic
in Houston, Texas and all future hearing assessments on the ISS will employ this Kuduwave
audiometer.”

**Dr Richard Danielson**

*Manager for Audiology & Hearing Conservation, Human Health & Performance, NASA-Johnson Space
Center, Houston, Texas, USA*

## Frequently asked questions about health insurance

### What is health insurance?

Health insurance is a plan, or policy, that covers a percentage of doctors’ visits and hospital
bills. It helps offset the costs of both planned and unplanned medical needs. Medical care can be
expensive, but health insurance may help lessen the financial burden.

And health insurance isn’t just for when you’re sick or injured. It can also help you stay healthy
through preventive care and wellness programs. This may help you save money, too, by catching
potential health concerns before they become larger issues.

### How does health insurance work?

Health insurance is a contract between you and an insurance company (the insurer). When you purchase
a plan, you become a member of that plan. Each month, you’ll likely pay a fee, called a premium, to
use the plan.

There are many different types of health plans, but they generally work the same way. You pay for
some medical costs and your insurer pays for some costs. How those costs break out depend on your
specific plan benefits and coverage.

[Learn more about how health insurance works][17]

### How do I get health insurance?

Finding the right health insurance plan depends on a variety of factors. These include things like
your age, health and financial situation. For example, if you’re over 65 or have a qualifying
disability or special situation, you may be eligible for [Medicare][18]. If you have a lower income,
you may qualify for [Medicaid][19]. If you want to purchase an individual plan, an [Affordable Care
Act (ACA)][20] plan could be an option. Or, you may have the option to get [health insurance through
your employer][21].

Most health insurance plans have a special period of time, usually once a year, when you can enroll.
This is called open enrollment. It’s when you can start, stop or change your health plan. Timing of
open enrollment varies based on the plan.

[Learn more about open enrollment][22]

### What are the different types of health insurance?

There are a variety of health insurance plans that fit different needs. Some plans are offered
through the government, like [Affordable Care Act (ACA)][23] plans, [Medicare][24] plans and
[Medicaid][25] plans. There are also health plans you can get through your employer. Or, you can
purchase a plan on your own, like [short term health insurance][26] that offers coverage for a
limited amount of time. Understanding the different health insurance options can help you find the
plan that may work best for you.

You may also see terms like HMO, PPO, EPO and POS ­— these refer to the four basic kinds of provider
networks that certain health plans may offer. A network may include doctors, hospitals and other
providers that agree to provide services to plan members at a negotiated rate. This may help lower
your out-of-pocket costs.

[Learn more about the different types of health insurance][27]

### How much does health insurance cost?

It depends. A variety of factors impact how much you pay. These can include your age, your location
and lifestyle habits. It also depends on the type of plan you choose. With some plans, you may pay
less up front, but more when you receive care. For other plans, the opposite can be true.

[Learn more about health insurance costs][28]

plan.

through the government, like [Affordable Care Act (ACA)][23] plans, [Medicare][24] plans and
[Medicaid][25] plans. There are also health plans you can get through your employer. Or, you can
purchase a plan on your own, like [short term health insurance][26] that offers coverage for a
limited amount of time. Understanding the different health insurance options can help you find the
plan that may work best for you.

You may also see terms like HMO, PPO, EPO and POS ­— these refer to the four basic kinds of provider
networks that certain health plans may offer. A network may include doctors, hospitals and other
providers that agree to provide services to plan members at a negotiated rate. This may help lower
your out-of-pocket costs.

[Learn more about the different types of health insurance][27]

### How much does health insurance cost?

It depends. A variety of factors impact how much you pay. These can include your age, your location
and lifestyle habits. It also depends on the type of plan you choose. With some plans, you may pay
less up front, but more when you receive care. For other plans, the opposite can be true.

[Learn more about health insurance costs][28]

### What does health insurance cover?

Coverage is unique to each health plan. Many plans may cover things like preventive care,
prescription drugs, hospital stays, mental health services and more. A plan may cover the full cost
of certain services, or you may have to share costs (by paying a copay or coinsurance, for example)
until you meet a deductible or out-of-pocket limit.

Make sure to review benefits and coverage before choosing a plan. You can find this information in
the plan’s Summary of Benefits and Coverage. This is a document that all health plan companies are
required to provide. It outlines what’s covered, partially covered or not covered under a health
plan.

[Learn how to review a Summary of Benefits and Coverage][29]
[Learn more about health insurance][30]
[Get the facts about how the health system works][31]

## Working to make the health care experience better

UnitedHealthcare puts care at the heart of health insurance. Empathy, transparency and human
connection guide us. Because better care comes from understanding what people need — and making
quality care more personal.

Helping support your business safeguard its most valuable resource!

## Service Categories

[ [Pre-Placement & Pre-Employment Assessments] ][29]

### [Pre-Placement Health Assessment][30]

A key management tool that forms part of the recruitment process. This service aims to ensure that
newly placed employees’ health is sufficient to enable them to safely fulfill the duties of their
post, whilst also considering the safety of others.

[ More about service ][31]

### [Health Surveillance][32]

A system of ongoing health checks. These health checks, which are required by law, aim to detect
potential work-related ill-health at an early stage, enabling an employer to evaluate health risks
and implement and maintain adequate and appropriate control measures.
[ More about service ][33]
[ [Health Surveillance] ][34]
[ [Management Referrals] ][35]

### [Management Referrals][36]

A high quality and customer focused service enabling an employer to refer an employee for
independent health advice. The service aims to find solutions where an employee’s health may be
affecting their fitness to carry out their role, or their role may be adversely affecting their
health in some way.
[ More about service ][37]

### [Health & Wellbeing][38]

Unique and bespoke Health & Wellbeing services which provide employers with a range of effective
‘off the shelf’ tools to help improve health and well-being in the workplace and beyond.

# Empowering good work through healthier people

We are a trusted partner for occupational health and wellbeing services, supporting organisations
throughout the employee lifecycle with flexible, high-quality solutions. We are driven by innovation
and integrity, to deliver meaningful and actionable outcomes that create healthier people and safer
workplaces.

[View our services][13]

to reach every organisation.

With a 99% customer retention rate, we build long-term partnerships that support employee health,
wellbeing and your business goals.

## Our services

We provide a comprehensive range of occupational health and wellbeing services that support
organisations throughout the employee lifecycle including pre-placement health screening and
onboarding support, occupational health assessments, vaccinations, absence management, ill-health
retirement applications, statutory health surveillance, treatment, and wellbeing services.

## By combining clinical expertise with innovative thinking, we can help organisations build
## healthier, safer and more successful workplaces.

We support organisations with expert occupational health services designed around the needs of their
people. By providing fast access to experienced clinicians and practical, evidence-based advice, we
help employers create healthier workplaces while giving employees the support they need to succeed
at work.

[Watch video][30]
[Healthy people drive stronger business outcomes - Jackie Salvidge, CEO]

## We’re transforming occupational health with our bigger picture approach

We view wellbeing through a biopsychosocial model, a clinically led approach to occupational health
assessments and workplace health management, enabling us to assess the wider factors affecting
health. By understanding the biological, psychological and social influences that impact an
individual, we can make more practical recommendations to drive positive change for people and
organisations. This enables you to overcome barriers around employees returning to work, remaining
in work and supporting them to perform at their best.

We achieve this by allocating referrals to our multi-disciplinary team of experts based on
individual need, including Occupational Health Physicians, Occupational Health Advisors (OHAs),
Mental Health Clinicians, and Physiotherapists. This approach is proven to reduce the length and
frequency of short-term absence, reduce the progression of cases becoming long term, and support
safe and sustained return to work.

## Primary Care

We offer comprehensive primary care designed to keep you healthy year-round. With in-person and
virtual appointments, on-site lab testing, and access to our pharmacy, we provide ongoing checkups,
preventive care, chronic condition management, and personalized treatment to support your long-term
wellness.

[woman with allergy][woman with allergy]
Comprehensive Primary Care
* Annual wellness exams and physicals
* New patient exams and preventive screenings
* Health maintenance visits and care coordination
* Same-day sick visits for non-emergency concerns
Chronic Disease Management
* Diabetes care and blood sugar monitoring
* High blood pressure (hypertension) management
* High cholesterol treatment
* Asthma and COPD management
* Thyroid disorder management
* Obesity and metabolic health care
Women’s Health
* Pap smears and cervical cancer screening
* Birth control counseling and prescriptions
* Menstrual and hormonal health
* Menopause management
* Breast exams and mammogram referrals
* Preconception and fertility counseling
Men’s Health
* Testosterone and hormone evaluation
* Prostate screening (PSA testing)
* Erectile dysfunction and sexual health
* Weight management and metabolic wellness
Senior & Geriatric Care
* Medicare annual wellness visits
* Fall prevention assessments
* Chronic disease coordination
* Medication review and optimization
* Cognitive and memory evaluations
Pediatric & Adolescent Care
* Well-child exams and school physicals
* Vaccinations and immunization updates
* Growth, nutrition, and behavioral health
* Sports and camp physicals
Lifestyle & Integrative Medicine
* Nutrition counseling and weight-loss programs
* Gut health and hormone balance
* Holistic wellness and stress management
* Smoking cessation and habit change support
Preventive & Diagnostic Screenings
* Routine bloodwork and labs
* Cancer screening and early detection
* Cholesterol, thyroid, and vitamin testing
* STD testing and counseling
* EKGs and cardiac evaluations
Behavioral & Mental Health Support
* Anxiety and depression screening
* Stress management and sleep counseling
* Lifestyle and mindfulness coaching
* Referrals for therapy and psychiatry

## Urgent Care

We are a full-service urgent care offering in-person and virtual visits, on-site X-ray, on-site
pharmacy, on-site lab testing, and virtual check-in. From everyday injuries to sudden illnesses, our
team provides fast, convenient, and comprehensive care when you need it most.

## Urgent Care

We are a full-service urgent care offering in-person and virtual visits, on-site X-ray, on-site
pharmacy, on-site lab testing, and virtual check-in. From everyday injuries to sudden illnesses, our
team provides fast, convenient, and comprehensive care when you need it most.

Common Illness Treatment
* Colds, flu, and upper respiratory infections
* Sore throat and strep testing
* Ear infections and ear wax removal
* Sinus infections and allergies
* Bronchitis, cough, and pneumonia evaluation
* Fever, fatigue, and dehydration treatment
Injury Care
* Minor cuts, scrapes, and wound care
* Stitches and laceration repair
* Sprains, strains, and sports injuries
* Minor burns and skin abrasions
* Fracture evaluation and splinting

## Testing, Training, and Books

## Implant & Device Testing

MAGNETIC RESONANCE SAFETY TESTING SERVICES is a highly experienced MRI-safety testing company that
conducts comprehensive evaluations of implants, devices, objects, and materials. For information,
visit [**MagneticResonanceSafetyTesting.com**][6]

### MRI Textbook

**MRI BIOEFFECTS, SAFETY, AND PATIENT MANAGEMENT: SECOND EDITION.** A comprehensive, authoritative
textbook on MRI health & safety concerns with contributions from more than fifty internationally
respected experts in the field. This is the definitive textbook on MRI safety for radiologists and
other physicians, MRI technologists, physicists, scientists, MRI facility managers, and others. Book
version is available on [**Amazon.com**][7]. The **PDF version** is available at
[**MRIsafetybook.com**][8]

### MRI Safety Training

Training is available through AppliedRadiology.com. Programs for MR personnel include: "Introduction
to MRI Safety", "Basic MRI Safety Training", and "Advanced MRI Safety Training For Healthcare
Professionals". Please visit: [appliedradiology.org/MRISafety/][9]

### IMRSER

The Institute for Magnetic Resonance Safety, Education, and Research (IMRSER) was formed in response
to the growing need for information and research regarding MRI safety. IMRSER promotes awareness,
understanding, and communication of MR safety issues through education and research. Visit:
[**IMRSER.org**][10]

### MRI Safety Videos

Videos Available on IMRSER include: MRI Safety Training Programs for Levels 1 and 2 MR Personnel,
What to Expect During Your MRI, Projectile/Missile Effect videos, and Superconducting magnet
quenching shown from both inside and outside the MR system room. Visit: [**IMRSER Videos**][11]

Quickly search hundreds of MRI safety related articles.

### Screening Form

Download MRI pre-screening forms for patients and MR personnel. English and Spanish forms are
available.
* [More Info & Download][14]

### Product Testing

Information of MRI testing of medical implants, materials, and devices performed by Magnetic
Resonance Safety Testing Services. Testing procedures are in accordance with the guidelines from The
American Society for Testing and Materials (ASTM) International.
* [More Info][15]

### Biomedical Lectures

Dr. Shellock is regularly invited to lecture at national and international scientific and medical
conferences and meetings. He is available to lecture on several magnetic resonance safety topics:
* [More Info][16]

### About Dr. Shellock

Frank G. Shellock, Ph.D. is a physiologist with more than 30 years of experience conducting
laboratory and clinical investigations in the field of magnetic resonance imaging.

## WHO ARE WE?

Every day, at Ziqitza Healthcare Limited (ZHL), we come across medical cases that truly move us,
most of them with the need for urgent medical care. There is only one true way of providing it - to
always be prepared, to be equipped, and to be committed.

Our brand name Ziqitza ( jigyasa + chikitsa) sums up beautifully our efforts to provide the best in
urgent medical response care to those who need it the most ANYWHERE in India be it in rural, urban,
corporates or hospitals. Our motto is that We Commit to Care, Aspire to be the Best, Revolutionize
Services and to Expand our service reach.

We, at Ziqitza, understand that much can be done to save lives in the spur of the moment and
endeavor to deliver prompt services with just one call. Our services include Ambulances, Medical
Helplines, Mobile Medical Units and Corporate Health Solutions ranging from ambulance/ doctor/
medical room which are tailored to provide the best in Emergency Medical Response to patients and
clients.

## WHO ARE WE?

Every day, at Ziqitza Healthcare Limited (ZHL), we come across medical cases that truly move us,
most of them with the need for urgent medical care. There is only one true way of providing it - to
always be prepared, to be equipped, and to be committed.

Our brand name Ziqitza ( jigyasa + chikitsa) sums up beautifully our efforts to provide the best in
urgent medical response care to those who need it the most ANYWHERE in India be it in rural, urban,
corporates or hospitals. Our motto is that We Commit to Care, Aspire to be the Best, Revolutionize
Services and to Expand our service reach.

We, at Ziqitza, understand that much can be done to save lives in the spur of the moment and
endeavor to deliver prompt services with just one call. Our services include Ambulances, Medical
Helplines, Mobile Medical Units and Corporate Health Solutions ranging from ambulance/ doctor/
medical room which are tailored to provide the best in Emergency Medical Response to patients and
clients.

# **Occupational Health and Wellbeing Solutions.**

## Your Partner in Health. Clinician-Led. Not-for-Profit. Here for You.

[ Request Support ][86]

Welcome to OH One: The UK's Not-for-Profit Occupational Health Provider for Business, HR & Employee
Wellbeing

At OH One, we deliver outstanding occupational health and wellbeing services to businesses across
the UK. As a SEQOHS-accredited provider, we set the standard for safety, quality, and effectiveness
in occupational health. Our personalised approach ensures every solution is tailored to meet the
specific needs of your organisation, helping you create a healthier, happier, and more productive
workforce.

Whether you need ad-hoc support, one-off interventions, or long-term strategies, OH One offers the
flexibility to provide the right services at the right time. By combining quality care with value,
we help businesses of all sizes achieve their health and wellbeing goals while enhancing employee
satisfaction and productivity.

Why OH One?

At OH One, we combine clinical expertise with a personal touch. Our timely and responsive approach
ensures your health concerns are addressed swiftly, helping your employees recover faster and return
to work with renewed energy.

Our reputation for excellence is reflected in our SEQOHS accreditation, and our services are
endorsed by Dr David C Batman, a leading Occupational Health Expert and Consultant Occupational
Health Physician.

We work with UK businesses across a range of industries, from SMEs to large organisations,
delivering practical and cost-effective solutions that drive results.

To learn more about what makes OH One the trusted choice for occupational health, visit our [Why
Choose Us ][87]page.

[Get in touch][88] with us today for a free consultation to discover how we can build a healthier,
happier future for your business.

Our Bespoke Health and Wellbeing Solutions

  obligations with tailored programmes that include HAVS assessments, audiometry, skin checks, and
  more. Our process is efficient, confidential, and aligned with the latest UK workplace health
  standards.

# IMPROVING LIVES IN RURAL AND REMOTE COMMUNITIES

Wilderness Medical Staffing places physicians, physician assistants, nurse practitioners, and CRNAs
in exciting locum tenens opportunities throughout rural and remote communities in the Northwest and
Alaska. WMS providers deliver essential medical care to these areas, ensuring communities receive
the healthcare they deserve. Whether you’re a provider looking for a fulfilling opportunity or a
client seeking skilled medical professionals, we’re here to connect you.

[START YOUR ADVENTURE][50] [GET STARTED STAFFING][51] [VIEW OPEN JOBS][52]

## BRINGING COMPASSIONATE HEALTHCARE PROFESSIONALS TO COMMUNITIES IN NEED

At Wilderness Medical Staffing, we connect nurse practitioners, physicians, physician assistants and
CRNAs with unique and rewarding opportunities to ignite their passion for medicine. Our exciting
locum tenens placements cater to healthcare providers at every career stage. Serving healthcare
facilities and industrial employers across the Northwest and Alaska, we are the only firm dedicated
exclusively to these regions. With our extensive experience, we expertly manage all placement
details, ensuring a seamless process for both providers and clients. Watch our video to discover our
mission and how we can meet your staffing or career needs.

[FIND LOCUM OPPORTUNITIES][53] [LEARN MORE ABOUT STAFFING][54]

### Mary Ellen Doty, NP, Explains Why She Started WMS

## YOUR HEALTHCARE STAFFING AGENCY

Understanding the unique demands of staffing in rural and remote areas, we ensure the WMS providers
and the employers we work with are matched based on shared goals of providing excellent medical care
to deserving communities.
* #### RURAL AND REMOTE FOCUSED
  
  WMS healthcare providers work exclusively for employers in rural and remote areas of Alaska,
  Montana, Washington, Wyoming, Idaho, and Colorado.
* #### COMPETITIVE RATES AND PAY
  
  Providers earn the pay they deserve, while employers stay profitable by providing continuous care
  for their communities.
* #### FLEXIBLE ASSIGNMENTS
  
  By creating schedules that work best for each client, providers have flexibility of when and where
  to work.

[VIEW OPEN JOBS][55] [GET STARTED STAFFING][56]

## For Medical Providers

### A SPIRIT OF CARING, A SPIRIT OF EXPLORATION

Medicine is an adventure. That’s one of the reasons you devoted your life to caring for others. Now,
take that adventure to the next level with a locum tenens placement through Wilderness Medical
Staffing. The life you change the most may be your own.

### THE CHOICE IS
### STILL YOURS

Because locum tenens placements through Wilderness Medical Staffing are so flexible and
well-compensated, they’re perfect for healthcare careers at any stage. Choose where, when, and how
long you want your short or long-term locum tenens job to be, and we’ll get you started.

[LEARN MORE ABOUT WORKING WITH WMS][57]

## For Employers

### WE ARE RURAL LOCUM TENENS
### PLACEMENT EXPERTS

By focusing on staffing nurse practitioners, physician assistants, and physicians experienced in
rural and remote areas, WMS ensures that clients receive tailored locum tenens staffing solutions
that meet the unique challenges of your community. Our providers specialize in primary care, urgent
care, emergency medicine, pediatrics, and behavioral health.

Serving over 200 clients, we collaborate with a diverse array of facilities including critical
access hospitals, integrated health systems, private clinics, tribal health organizations, and
industry partners in need of comprehensive occupational health support thoughout the Northwestern
United States and Alaska.

## Amazing health starts with amazing healthcare.

When healthcare is easy, people are healthier.
When people are healthier, their organizations thrive.

## Healthcare is better with Premise.

[How we’re different][72][Our results][73][Advanced primary care][74]

## 30% savings with Premise Health.

When people are healthier, their organizations can thrive. In a claims-based analysis of 207,000
eligible lives from across 26 organizations, the results were clear: advanced primary care leads to
better health and lower healthcare costs. The study methodology was validated by Milliman, an
independently recognized actuary.

[Read success story][75]

## Great care anywhere.

Millions of members. More than 400 employer, union, and health plan partners. A national presence.
Premise is the leading direct healthcare company in the nation, with 800 wellness centers across 46
states and Guam. It offers more than 30 types of care and a proven model that improves health and
reduces healthcare costs for you and your people.

## The proof is in the outcomes.

### 30%

Average total cost of care savings

### 52%

Reduction in inpatient hospital admissions

### 20%

Increase in routine, preventive, and mental health office visits

### 17%

Reduction in emergency room visits

## Putting the “advanced” in advanced primary care.

Have you heard about advanced primary care? It combines easy access, helpful technology, and
whole-person care to improve population health. Our approach brings better healthcare to members and
real value to their organizations.

### Convenient, integrated mental health

### Comprehensive, easy-to-access primary care

### High-touch, consultative pharmacy

### Data-driven, proactive condition management

### Concierge care navigation and referrals

### Employers

][77]

Better healthcare for your employees and their families, right where they work or live.

## More access, more value.

At Premise, we’re recreating healthcare to be everything you need it to be. We’re removing barriers
instead of putting them up so we can serve your mind, body, and spirit.

## Healthcare made for you.

Next-day appointments and short wait times. A user-friendly app and a team you know and trust. At
Premise, you’re a member – not a number. We redesigned healthcare from the ground up to make it easy
to get the care you need to be your best.  

[Learn more][85]

When healthcare is easy, people are healthier.

## Healthcare is better with Premise.

## 30% savings with Premise Health.

When people are healthier, their organizations can thrive. In a claims-based analysis of 207,000
eligible lives from across 26 organizations, the results were clear: advanced primary care leads to
better health and lower healthcare costs. The study methodology was validated by Milliman, an
independently recognized actuary.

[Read success story][75]

## Great care anywhere.

Millions of members. More than 400 employer, union, and health plan partners. A national presence.
Premise is the leading direct healthcare company in the nation, with 800 wellness centers across 46
states and Guam. It offers more than 30 types of care and a proven model that improves health and
reduces healthcare costs for you and your people.

# Smart Occupational Health

ROC is a dynamic and proactive occupational health company providing exceptional private healthcare
services. Working across many industries, we are the market leaders in providing a bespoke,
productive service, ranging from multinational corporations to small local businesses. Our
Clinicians are registered with the FCDO and are very experienced in providing visa medical services.

[Contact Us][43]
[Book an appointment][44]

**What we do**

ROC works with top specialists in private medicine to deliver a comprehensive, tailored occupational
health service across a wide range of industries.

[Read More >][45]

**Locations**

We manage clients at [locations][46] throughout the world from our offices in **[Harley Street,
London][47]**, and **[Westhill, Aberdee][48][n][49]**. To date we have delivered OH consultancy
services to the UK, Norway, France, Europe, US, Brazil, Africa and the Middle East.

**Offshore Health Specialists**

Our team provide the expert support that companies operating offshore require, which allows us to
deliver a solution to all challenges. Whether it is 24/7 advice or a medical requirement, our
clinicians have extensive experience in Offshore Medicine and Remote Healthcare.

[Read More >][50]

**We work with some amazing clients:**

[Orsted][Orsted] [Diamond Offshore 1][Diamond Offshore 1] [Assala Energy 1][Assala Energy 1] [Africa
Oil Corp][Africa Oil Corp]

## **Our Occupational Health** **Services**

We cover a comprehensive range of services to support your company’s health requirements.

### **Offshore Medicals**

Offshore workers must undertake a medical examination that classifies them as medically fit to work
before travelling offshore. Our doctors are approved to conduct Oil & Gas UK (OGUK) Medicals as well
as Wind and Turbine Medicals.

[Read More >][51]

### **Case Management**

Case Management improves outcomes in sickness absence, rehabilitation, work related illness/injury,
and ill-health retirement. ROC Health helps workers back to full capacity so they can make a safe
return to work.

[Read More >][52]

### **Health Surveillance**

Promoting the systematic, early identification of work-related ill-health to aid treatment and
prevent further damage, health surveillance can be necessary to meet statutory, non-statutory or UK
legal requirements.

[Read More >][53]

### **Cruise Ship Medicals (PEME & REME)**

At our CQC-regulated clinic in London and HIS-regulated clinic in Aberdeen, we deliver fully
compliant cruise ship medicals with fast turnaround times, on-site diagnostics, and expert knowledge
of cruise line requirements.

[Read More >][54]

### **D4 Driver Medicals – HGV, LGV, PCV & C1 Medicals**

We provide DVLA D4 driver medicals for HGV, LGV, PCV and C1 drivers across Aberdeen and London,
ensuring you remain compliant with Driver and Vehicle Licensing Agency (DVLA) Group 2 medical
standards.

[Read More >][55]

### ******Travel Health******

We provide pre-travel medicals, vaccinations, malaria prevention, and country-specific health advice
at our clinics in London and Aberdeen to help employees stay healthy while working abroad. All our
clinics are Yellow Fever registered centres.

[Read More >][56]

[See our full range of services >][57]

mental health support, we tailor solutions to your organisation’s needs.

[Learn more][50]

 

### Ready to partner with us?

Are you ready to embark on a journey to occupational health excellence? [Contact our team][51] today
to discuss your organisation’s needs and explore how we can support your quest for a healthier,
happier workforce.

## Frequently asked questions

#### Does OH support employer/employee or both?

Both! There is often a misconception that occupational health only benefits an employer. This isn’t
the case. Occupational health is mutually beneficial for both an employer and employees.

As an employer, occupational health helps you make decisions with respect to health and safety in
the workplace, where it specifically relates to employees. The information and advice given to
employers is in practical, not medical terms, with the aim of making the working environment a
compliant, safe place for employees and flagging any adjustments that may need to be made.

As an employee, occupational health benefits you as you have the right to be able to complete your
job in a safe, healthy environment that prioritises your wellbeing.

#### Do I need to sign into an agreement/What support packages do you have on offer?

For any occupational health work to be carried out, we require a contractual agreement in place. Our
desire is to become your independent occupational health provider and support you on an ongoing
basis, rather than a one-off.

We work closely with prospective clients to understand their needs to provide them with the best
solution for their organisation – this could be a contract with monthly billing to cover any
occupational work undertaken, or we can offer an inclusion-based package.

mental health support, we tailor solutions to your organisation’s needs.

Are you ready to embark on a journey to occupational health excellence? [Contact our team][51] today
to discuss your organisation’s needs and explore how we can support your quest for a healthier,
happier workforce.

## Frequently asked questions

#### Does OH support employer/employee or both?

Both! There is often a misconception that occupational health only benefits an employer. This isn’t
the case. Occupational health is mutually beneficial for both an employer and employees.

As an employer, occupational health helps you make decisions with respect to health and safety in
the workplace, where it specifically relates to employees. The information and advice given to
employers is in practical, not medical terms, with the aim of making the working environment a
compliant, safe place for employees and flagging any adjustments that may need to be made.

As an employee, occupational health benefits you as you have the right to be able to complete your
job in a safe, healthy environment that prioritises your wellbeing.

#### Do I need to sign into an agreement/What support packages do you have on offer?

For any occupational health work to be carried out, we require a contractual agreement in place. Our
desire is to become your independent occupational health provider and support you on an ongoing
basis, rather than a one-off.

We work closely with prospective clients to understand their needs to provide them with the best
solution for their organisation – this could be a contract with monthly billing to cover any
occupational work undertaken, or we can offer an inclusion-based package.

## **Could Your Business Benefit from a Healthier, More Productive Workforce?**

Valentine Occupational Health deliver tailored and quality Occupational Health and Wellbeing
solutions across the UK – building trusted partnerships with our Clients to help them care for their
people and thrive.

We understand the challenges organisations face when sourcing reliable, effective Occupational
Health services. Our bespoke health and wellbeing packages are designed to improve workforce
wellbeing, enhance productivity, and reduce the financial impact of sickness absence.

Our specialists provide expert assessments and practical advice on preventative measures, helping
you strengthen resilience and minimise workplace disruption. By partnering with Valentine
Occupational Health, you gain a trusted advisor dedicated to protecting your people and supporting
your organisation’s success.

## **Could Your Business Benefit from a Healthier, More Productive Workforce?**

Valentine Occupational Health deliver tailored and quality Occupational Health and Wellbeing
solutions across the UK – building trusted partnerships with our Clients to help them care for their
people and thrive.

We understand the challenges organisations face when sourcing reliable, effective Occupational
Health services. Our bespoke health and wellbeing packages are designed to improve workforce
wellbeing, enhance productivity, and reduce the financial impact of sickness absence.

Our specialists provide expert assessments and practical advice on preventative measures, helping
you strengthen resilience and minimise workplace disruption. By partnering with Valentine
Occupational Health, you gain a trusted advisor dedicated to protecting your people and supporting
your organisation’s success.

# Whatishumanresource.com

Human Resource refer to the individuals or personnel or workforce within an organisation responsible
for performing the tasks given to them for the purpose of achievement of goals and objectives of the
organisation which is possible only through proper recruitment and selection, providing proper
orientation an induction, training, skill developments, proper assessment of employees (performance
appraisal), providing appropriate compensation and benefits, maintaining proper labour relations and
ultimately maintaining safety, welfare and health concern of employees, which is process of the
human resource management.

Father of Human Resource Management  [George Elton Mayo][30] >>
